title: UnreviewedActivationRecordedPayload
description: Payload of the UnreviewedActivationRecorded event (INV-REQ-952, INV-NOTE-3#def:FR-AB.5): a regulatory pack was activated for the tenant after its grace window expired without review. It is a fact for the next period's readiness output, never an error or a blocker. packType and packVersion carry the bounds of RegulatoryPack.packType and RegulatoryPack.version in openapi.yaml; this schema is the single source of those two bounds for the submission contract. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

tenantId.description: The tenant whose activation proceeded without review.

packType.description: The type of the activated regulatory pack.

packVersion.description: The version of the activated regulatory pack.

effectiveFrom.description: The effective date of the activated pack.

reviewed.description: Always false: the activation proceeded without the tenant's review.
